divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

input: exemplar records selected from the Ensembl VEP 116.2 reference outputs of the suites listed in manifest.json (ClinVar GRCh38, gnomAD v4.1 chromosome 21, 1000 Genomes high-coverage chromosome 21, the structural-variant set), two per consequence-set combination, with --cache ordering the candidates by the bytes their transcripts add to the pruned cache, cheapest first, and one exemplar of every variant class the references show
generator: scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite <id>=<reference>=<input> (one per entry of the manifest's suites table) --k 2 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --multi-allelic-per-suite 4 --cache <json cache> --out tests/golden/116/GRCh38; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify
